# Whatfix

> Whatfix is an AI-powered digital adoption platform that guides users through enterprise software with in-app guidance, analytics, and training capabilities.

Whatfix provides a comprehensive suite of products including Digital Adoption Platform, Product Analytics, and Mirror AI training software. The platform serves Fortune 1000 enterprises across banking, healthcare, insurance, financial services, and other industries, enabling digital transformation, change management, and user onboarding.

## Key Topics

- Digital Adoption Platform
- Product Analytics
- AI Agents
- In-App Guidance
- Mirror AI Training
- Smart Tips
- Whatfix Flows
- User Onboarding
- Change Management
- Insights Agent
- Salesforce Integration
- Workflow Optimization
- Employee Training
- Digital Transformation
- ScreenSense

## Core Products

- [Whatfix | AI-Powered Digital Adoption Platform](https://whatfix.com): Whatfix homepage showcasing AI-powered digital adoption platform with in-app guidance and analytics.
- [Explore All Products | Whatfix](https://whatfix.com/products): Main products overview page featuring Digital Adoption Platform, Analytics, and Mirror.
- [Whatfix | Digital Adoption Platform](https://whatfix.com/products/digital-adoption-platform): Core product page for Whatfix DAP with Guidance and Insights Agents.
- [Whatfix | Product Analytics Software](https://whatfix.com/products/product-analytics): Product Analytics offering with AutoCapture, Session Replay, and AI Insights.
- [Whatfix Mirror | Simulation Training & AI Roleplay Software](https://whatfix.com/products/mirror): Mirror AI training platform for sandbox practice and roleplay simulations.

## Use Case Solutions

- [Explore All Solutions | Whatfix](https://whatfix.com/solutions): Solutions directory for Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, and Microsoft integrations.
- [Whatfix for AI Adoption](https://whatfix.com/solutions/ai-adoption): Solution for accelerating GenAI technology adoption with in-app guidance.
- [Whatfix for Change Acceleration](https://whatfix.com/solutions/change-management): Change management solution with Flows, Smart Tips, Tours, and Self Help.
- [Whatfix for Digital Transformation](https://whatfix.com/solutions/digital-transformation): Digital transformation solution streamlining workflows and accelerating rollouts.
- [Whatfix for Employee Training](https://whatfix.com/solutions/elearning): Employee training solution with guided onboarding and sandbox training.
- [Whatfix for Feature Adoption](https://whatfix.com/solutions/feature-adoption): Feature adoption solution guiding users to discover and embrace new features.
- [User Onboarding Software - Whatfix](https://whatfix.com/solutions/user-onboarding): All-in-one user onboarding software for Fortune 1000 with personalized guidance.
- [Whatfix for User Support](https://whatfix.com/solutions/self-service-support): User support solution with Smart Tips, Self Help, and AI-powered knowledge.
- [Whatfix for Workflow Optimization](https://whatfix.com/solutions/task-optimization): Workflow optimization solution shortening cycle times and eliminating errors.

## Industry Solutions

- [Whatfix for Banking](https://whatfix.com/solutions/digital-banking): Banking solution for nCino, Finastra, and Salesforce with compliance support.
- [Whatfix for Financial Services](https://whatfix.com/solutions/financial-services): Financial services solution for advisors and analysts with compliance management.
- [Whatfix for Insurance](https://whatfix.com/solutions/insurance): Insurance solution for Guidewire, Duck Creek, and claims processing.
- [Whatfix for Healthcare](https://whatfix.com/solutions/healthcare): Healthcare solution with HIPAA compliance and EHR training support.
- [Whatfix for Pharma & Life Sciences](https://whatfix.com/solutions/pharma-and-lifesciences): Pharma solution with Veeva integration and GxP compliance support.
- [Whatfix for Higher Education Institutions](https://whatfix.com/solutions/education): Higher education solution supporting admins, faculty, and students.
